softwood|ex1.translation_zh: 建筑公司经常使用软木木材来建造住宅。
softwood|ex1: softwood lumber | Construction companies frequently use softwood lumber for building residential homes.
softwood|ex2.translation_zh: 研究人员已确定几种适合可持续林业实践的软木树种。
softwood|ex2: softwood species | Researchers have identified several softwood species suitable for sustainable forestry practices.
softwood|ex3.translation_zh: 你可以在当地商店找到各种软木产品，如家具和地板。
softwood|ex3: softwood products | You can find various softwood products like furniture and flooring in local stores.
honor|def_zh: 尊敬或对成就或品质的认可
honor|ex1.translation_zh: 我们向为自由献身的人致以荣誉。
honor|ex1: pay honor to | We pay honor to those who sacrificed their lives for freedom.
honor|ex2.translation_zh: 她为朋友的晋升举办了一个庆祝派对。
honor|ex2: in honor of | She organized a party in honor of her friend's promotion.
honor|ex3.translation_zh: 他们必须遵守按时完成项目的承诺。
honor|ex3: honor the commitment | They must honor the commitment to complete the project on time.
proceeding|def_zh: 正在进行的事件或行动
proceeding|ex1.translation_zh: 对该公司的法律程序正在进行中，将于下个月结束。
proceeding|ex1: legal proceeding | Legal proceedings against the company are ongoing and will conclude next month.
proceeding|ex2.translation_zh: 与此案相关的法庭程序预计下周将恢复进行。
proceeding|ex2: court proceeding | Court proceedings related to the case are expected to resume next week.
proceeding|ex3.translation_zh: 会议的学术程序将在早晨开始进行。
proceeding|ex3: academic proceeding | Academic proceedings for the conference will start early in the morning.
diagnose|def_zh: 通过检查来识别疾病或问题
diagnose|ex1.translation_zh: 技术人员会诊断问题，以确保系统正常运作。
diagnose|ex1: diagnose a problem | Technicians diagnose a problem to ensure the system works properly.
diagnose|ex2.translation_zh: 医生可以根据病人的症状诊断疾病。
diagnose|ex2: diagnose an illness | Doctors can diagnose an illness based on the patient's symptoms.
diagnose|ex3.translation_zh: 研究人员旨在利用先进的成像技术诊断一种病症。
diagnose|ex3: diagnose a condition | Researchers aim to diagnose a condition using advanced imaging techniques.
precede|ex1.translation_zh: 在讨论这个主题之前，应该先提出几个重要观点。
precede|ex1: precede a discussion | Several important points should precede a discussion on this topic.
precede|ex2.translation_zh: 传统仪式通常在节日的主要活动之前举行。
precede|ex2: precede the main event | Traditional rituals often precede the main event of the festival.
precede|ex3.translation_zh: 新理论必须在实验研究的发现之前提出。
precede|ex3: precede the findings | New theories must precede the findings of the experimental research.
codify|def_zh: 法典化；将法规或规则编纂成册
codify|ex1.translation_zh: 立法者旨在法典化保护环境的法律，以惠及未来几代人。
codify|ex1: codify laws | Legislators aim to codify laws that protect the environment for future generations.
codify|ex2.translation_zh: 研究人员通常寻求在他们的领域内法典化伦理实践标准。
codify|ex2: codify standards | Researchers often seek to codify standards for ethical practices in their fields.
codify|ex3.translation_zh: 社区应共同努力法典化促进包容和尊重的原则。
codify|ex3: codify principles | Communities should work together to codify principles that promote inclusivity and respect.
baste|def_zh: 给食物涂抹汁液或脂肪
baste|ex1.translation_zh: 在准备盛宴时，许多厨师给火鸡涂抹肉汁以增强其风味。
baste|ex1: baste the turkey | When preparing the feast, many chefs baste the turkey to enhance its flavor.
baste|ex2.translation_zh: 厨师们经常用黄油涂抹，以使肉类表面呈现金黄色的外壳。
baste|ex2: baste with butter | Cooks often baste with butter to achieve a golden-brown crust on meats.
baste|ex3.translation_zh: 在节日期间，烤制时给鸡肉涂抹蒜蓉酱是传统做法。
baste|ex3: baste the chicken | During the festival, it is customary to baste the chicken with garlic sauce while grilling.
covetous|def_zh: 贪婪的；渴望拥有他人之物的
covetous|ex1.translation_zh: 人们看到他人拥有奢华物品时，常常表现出贪婪的行为。
covetous|ex1: covetous behavior | People often exhibit covetous behavior when they see others with luxurious items.
covetous|ex2.translation_zh: 他发现很难忽视自己对邻居汽车的贪婪想法。
covetous|ex2: covetous thoughts | He found it hard to ignore his covetous thoughts about his neighbor's car.
covetous|ex3.translation_zh: 在职场，贪婪的欲望可能导致不道德的竞争。
covetous|ex3: covetous desires | In the corporate world, covetous desires can lead to unethical competition.
equivocate|ex1.translation_zh: 政治家常常在问题上模棱两可，以同时吸引多个选民。
equivocate|ex1: equivocate on issues | Politicians often equivocate on issues to appeal to multiple voters simultaneously.
equivocate|ex2.translation_zh: 在会议期间，她决定对决策模棱两可，以维护团队士气。
equivocate|ex2: equivocate about decisions | During the meeting, she decided to equivocate about decisions to maintain team morale.
equivocate|ex3.translation_zh: 面试官可能会发现，在面试中倾向于模棱两可的候选人不那么值得信任。
equivocate|ex3: equivocate in interviews | Interviewers may find candidates who tend to equivocate in interviews less trustworthy.
immunity|ex1.translation_zh: 强大的免疫系统能提供更好的免疫力以抵抗各种感染。
immunity|ex1: immune system immunity | A strong immune system provides better immunity against various infections.
immunity|ex2.translation_zh: 实现群体免疫需要相当大比例的人口接种疫苗。
immunity|ex2: herd immunity | Achieving herd immunity requires a significant portion of the population to be vaccinated.
immunity|ex3.translation_zh: 儿童在经历水痘等常见疾病后通常会获得免疫力。
immunity|ex3: immunity to disease | Children often develop immunity to disease after common illnesses like chickenpox.
dissenter|ex1.translation_zh: 学者们经常发表批评，以凸显持不同政见者在争议话题上的观点。
dissenter|ex1: dissenter's views | Scholars often publish critiques to highlight a dissenter's views on controversial topics.
dissenter|ex2.translation_zh: 在会议期间，一位直言不讳的持不同政见者对提议立法的影响表示担忧。
dissenter|ex2: a vocal dissenter | During the meeting, a vocal dissenter raised concerns about the proposed legislation's impact.
dissenter|ex3.translation_zh: 这部电影展示了一位通过艺术挑战社会规范的持不同政见者。
dissenter|ex3: dissenting dissenter | The film featured a dissenting dissenter who challenged societal norms through his art.
melodious|ex1.translation_zh: 鸟儿常常发出悦耳的音调，让早晨更加明亮。
melodious|ex1: melodious tones | Birds often produce melodious tones that brighten up the morning.
melodious|ex2.translation_zh: 她以悦耳的嗓音歌唱，吸引了在场的每一个人。
melodious|ex2: melodious voice | She sang with a melodious voice, captivating everyone in the audience.
melodious|ex3.translation_zh: 班级在学习期间听着悦耳的旋律，帮助他们放松。
melodious|ex3: melodious melodies | The class listened to melodious melodies that helped them relax during study time.
